facets.description: Admin::GroupsController#add_members, line 66, requires group_id instead of the routed id, causing HTTP 400.
Admin::GroupsController#remove_member, line 85, requires group_id instead of the routed id, causing HTTP 400.
The .add_members controller specs pass group_id directly, masking the routing parameter mismatch.
The .remove_member controller specs pass group_id directly, masking the routing parameter mismatch.
Membership AJAX promise rejections are unhandled, leaving add/remove failures silent in the UI.
